note: foray-playback.test.js's playback half (NE-30j): REAL curated Forays end to end, from the frozen fixture (tools/foray/fixtures/frozen/data), built the way the page builds them (setup.forayBuild) and played through the real manager. Port card NE-30s; the Swift runner needs the page's build as input, not a resolver (runner.js forayBuildFor).

covers: foray-playback::pressing play loads segment 1 at its in-point and arms its out-point
cases.note: The frozen grilling-history-1, built as the page builds it: load at the in-point, rate, the boundary, then play.

covers: foray-playback::every segment plays through, in order, and the Foray then ends
foray-playback::every segment is loaded at its own in-point, never at 0:00
foray-playback::consecutive segments of the SAME episode are two loads, not one
foray-playback::the out-point armed for each segment is that segment's own end
cases.note: All 32 segments, each loaded at its own in-point with its own boundary, same-episode neighbours as separate loads, and then the Foray ends.

covers: foray-playback::every one of Foray #1's seams holds a beat, and neither end of it does
foray-playback::the beats cost a bounded share of the Foray, and cost no audio at all
cases.note: Every one of the 31 unbridged seams holds the full beat with the next segment already loaded, neither end has one, and no timer outlives the Foray.

covers: foray-playback::next skips to the following segment without playing the rest of the episode
foray-playback::previous restarts the current segment at its in-point, not at 0:00 of the episode
foray-playback::clicking a row jumps straight to that segment
foray-playback::a jump while playing pauses the outgoing segment first (no two audible at once)
cases.note: A jump pauses the outgoing segment first, then loads the chosen one at its in-point and arms its boundary.

covers: foray-playback::pause and resume keep the listener inside the segment
foray-playback::a missing source file costs its segments and nothing else
cases.note: moreish-jerk-jamaica's source is gone: its two segments are dropped at the build, and the rest plays to the end.

covers: foray-playback::segments.json going missing entirely leaves an empty, non-crashing Foray
foray-playback::the manager builds exactly the queue the surface rendered
cases.note: The queue the manager plays is the page's build, item for item, with nothing skipped.

covers: foray-playback::a position stored mid-Foray comes back to the same segment and the same second
foray-playback::resuming loads the segment at its in-point and only then seeks
cases.note: The client's resume: play the stored segment (loaded at its IN-POINT, boundary armed), then seek to the stored second — never a load straight at the offset.

covers: foray-playback::resuming keeps the rest of the Foray intact — it plays on to the end from there
foray-playback::a position stored against a longer version of the Foray does not resume past its end
cases.note: A resume clamped to the Foray's end lands inside its last real segment.

covers: foray-playback::1.5x set before play holds through all 9 seams of grilling-history-2
cases.note: One rate token per load plus the initial set, every one 1.5.

covers: foray-playback::a speed chosen mid-Foray survives every seam after it, at the top of the ladder
foray-playback::the seam beat stays SEAM_GAP_SEC of WALL clock at 2x — it does not scale with speed
cases.note: At 2x the beat still owes its full 500 ms: half of it is not the whole.
